site.title: Campus to Corporate Ready — Workshop Hub

hero.lede: Everything you need to run Campus to Corporate Ready — ten animated session decks, a full facilitator guide, participant handouts, and a modern-workplace supplement. Built for final-year students stepping into their first job.

resources.title: Facilitator Guide
resources.desc: 28 pages. Minute-by-minute timing, opening scripts, slide talking points, activity facilitation, and 2025 delivery notes for every session.

resources.title: Participant Handout Pack
resources.desc: Ten printable, fill-in worksheets — one per session. Company map, PREP practice, STAR builder, mindset audit, commitment card, and more.

resources.title: Program Toolkit
resources.desc: The pre-workshop diagnostic, the 30-day follow-up sequence, and the before/after impact scorecard — the pieces that make the learning stick.

resources.title: Industry Readiness Playbook
resources.desc: The campus-vs-industry gap, real-world simulations, tool fluency, and industry-specific tracks — for going beyond the two days.

resources.title: Modern Workplace 2025 Supplement
resources.desc: Ten standalone slides on AI at work, remote collaboration, the modern fresher toolkit, and three interactive QR moments. Slot into any session.

journey.p: Each session builds on the last — from understanding the workplace to walking out interview-ready. Every deck opens with objectives and closes with a quote, with real-world scenarios, data, and activities in between. Several include 2025 modern-workplace content: AI at work, remote collaboration, and scannable QR moments. View or download any deck straight from its stop on the path.

resources.p: The documents that turn a set of decks into a workshop anyone can deliver.

start.h: From download to delivery in four steps.

all.p: All ten session decks, the facilitator guide, handouts, program toolkit, industry playbook, and modern-workplace supplement — in one download. Every deck and document also has a View button that opens it straight in your browser, though animations only play properly in PowerPoint.

steps.p: The Facilitator Guide has minute-by-minute timing, opening scripts, and talking points for all ten sessions. Start there.
One Participant Handout Pack per person — ten fill-in worksheets that match each session. Print double-sided.
Open each session deck in PowerPoint. Animations advance on click. Swap the placeholder QR links for your own before delivery.
Use the Program Toolkit for the pre-workshop diagnostic, the 30-day follow-up, and the before/after impact scorecard.

footer.blurb: A complete, ready-to-deliver 2-day workshop that prepares final-year students for their first job — the shift from campus habits to corporate expectations.
footer.tagline: Built for trainers and the students they prepare.
